parameters.name: FlvSeekEnd
parameters.description: Set custom end parameters for FLV files.

parameters.name: FlvSeekStart
parameters.description: The custom start parameter for FLV files.

parameters.name: FlvVideoSeekMode
parameters.description:
FLV seeking. Valid values:

*   by_byte: seek by byte
*   by_time: seek by time.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The content of the rule. A conditional expression is used to match a user request. You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configuration. Use cases:

*   true: Match all incoming requests.
*   Set the value to a custom expression, for example:(http.host eq "video.example.com"): Match the specified request.

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Valid values: You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configuration. Specifies whether to check the image used by the instance supports hot migration. Valid values:

*   on
*   off

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the scheduling rule. You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The order in which the rule is executed. A smaller value gives priority to the rule.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The website ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the website configurations. You can use this parameter to specify a version of your website to apply the feature settings. By default, version 0 is used.

parameters.name: VideoSeekEnable
parameters.description:
Video seeking. Valid values:

*   on
*   off

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-video-processing --site-id 1234560000 --site-version 1 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --sequence 1 --video-seek-enable on --flv-video-seek-mode by_byte --mp4-seek-start start --mp4-seek-end end --flv-seek-start start --flv-seek-end end --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa CreateVideoProcessing --region cn-hangzhou --VideoSeekEnable on --SiteId 1234560000 --RuleEnable on --FlvVideoSeekMode by_byte --Mp4SeekEnd end --FlvSeekStart start --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --Sequence 1 --Mp4SeekStart start --SiteVersion 1 --FlvSeekEnd end --RuleName rule_example
